objective: Resolve and load one synthetic separate gate/up/down MoE FFN checkpoint stage into identified VoltaFabric CPU Sessions, preserving explicit checkpoint expert mapping and comparing against an independent scalar oracle.

donor.adapted_component: Typed no-allocation GGUF metadata and tensor-span lookup; exact expert tensor naming remains VoltaFabric policy.

verification.result: Exact output match against a separate scalar Q8_0 decoder/matvec oracle with SiLU(gate)*up and FP16 decode followed by one-time down-projection route weighting.

limitations: Synthetic CPU fixture only; no production checkpoint or model compatibility was tested.
The Session dispatcher still requires matrix output width to equal dispatch hidden width, so the rectangular shape was resolved but not executed.
Fused gate/up is recognized in metadata but not split or executed.
No full model generation, CUDA/V100, inter-PC worker, RDMA, production R53, or performance claim.
